items.title: Nvidia stock falls after investigation into CEO, bucking market rally
items.brief: Wall Street rallied sharply on Monday, despite a 4% decline in Nvidia shares, as markets continued to rebound from last week’s steep sell-off .

items.title: Judge denies Lindsay Clancy’s motion to dismiss murder charges, paving the way for potential retrial
items.brief: A judge in Massachusetts denied Lindsay Clancy’s motion to dismiss her murder charges, clearing the way for her to face a second trial for allegedly killing her three children.

items.title: Skydance plans to bundle HBO Max and Paramount+ next year
items.brief: Skydance will start selling HBO Max and Paramount+ together in a streaming bundle early next year, the company said Monday.

items.title: Trump isn’t done alienating his base — this time on ‘amnesty’
items.brief: It remains unlikely that President Donald Trump would ever sign off on giving millions of undocumented immigrants a path to legal status.

items.title: Plane rolls over after being hit by blast from jet engines
items.brief: The blast from the jet engines of a Boeing 737 sent a small plane with two people inside rolling onto its roof this weekend, the Federal Aviation Administration said in a statement.
